answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces topological cut verifications across clusters. To drink the reward nectar, nodes must post collateral. Auditing auditors cross-examine cluster connectivity like a mirror test to detect fake identities. When an attack cut is verified, automated stake slashing imposes superlinear attacker cost, dispersing fraudulent stake into a scorched plume of severed, unredeemable tokens.
